cases.scientific_interpretation: The source-backed equations and synthetic calibration coefficients replay without promoting physical evidence.
A Zeeman shift cannot estimate magnetic field without a calibrated transition response and field uncertainty.
A Stark shift cannot estimate electric field without a transition-specific polarizability authority.
A dynamic Stark response to blackbody radiation calibrates the electromagnetic thermal lane only.
Spinor representation of fields and curvature cannot be relabeled as particle mass.
Horizon compactness does not generate the weak-field DP collapse law.
The self-gravity versus yield-strength crossover is not a wave-function-collapse threshold.
Jeans instability compares pressure support with self-gravity and does not derive microscopic objective reduction.
No cross-scale benchmark may retune the frozen Stage-4.2C DP law.
Synthetic calibration and recovery calculations cannot satisfy empirical pilot or measured-evidence gates.
